name: mcpClient
description: Creates an MCP (Model Context Protocol) client that connects to an MCP server over HTTP or STDIO. Returns a client, or an array of clients when a configFile describing several servers is passed.

params.name: config
params.description: Struct with a transport key (type http with a url, or type stdio with a command and args), or a configFile path to a JSON file describing several servers. Optional keys include clientInfo, capabilities, initializationTimeout, requestTimeout and consumer functions such as loggingConsumer.

rustcfml.notes: Uses a different signature: mcpClient(name), where name is a server declared under mcpServers in .cfconfig.json. Returns the same client handle as mcpConnect(). Resolving a name requires serve mode with a loaded configuration; in a CLI run, use mcpConnect() with an explicit command or url.
